<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c','Y') and n['pixels']>15:
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
            if r1>=63 or c1>=63: continue
            out.append((n['color'], r0,c0,r1,c1))
    return sorted(out)
base = snap(current_frame)
print("base:", base)
action(['MOUSE']) if False else None
# test MOUSE on id7 center (row 29, col 50)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':29,'col':50}])
print("after MOUSE id7:", snap(current_frame))
action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:", snap(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("after RIGHT:", snap(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
